description.value: Krause Berry Farms is a family-owned 200+ acre working farm in Langley's Fraser Valley, operating since 1974, with U-pick berry fields, an award-winning estate winery, and a bustling market and bakery on site. The market is stocked year-round with farm-made pies, preserves, frozen meals, berry syrups, and specialty pantry items, while the Waffle Bar and café serve fresh hot food. It is a destination-worthy stop for cyclists riding the Fraser Valley agricultural routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms an active, multi-faceted farm operation in Langley, BC with a Market & Bakery, Café/Waffle Bar, U-pick fields, and Estate Winery — all publicly accessible. The address 6179 248th Street, Langley, BC is provided on the hours/contact subpage for the main farm (where the Market & Bakery is located). Hot food is explicitly confirmed via menu items listed (waffles, nachos, pizza, grilled cheese, chowder). Basic groceries are confirmed via the market description (preserves, frozen meals, pies, peanut butter, syrups, mixes). No bike parking, water, washrooms, or cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM name 'Krause Berry Farms Market & Bakery' refers to one component of the larger 'Krause Berry Farms & Estate Winery' operation; the main farm at 6179 248th St and a separate Farm Store & Café at 23823 72nd Ave, Langley are both listed on the website — OSM may only capture one location.
No phone number present in OSM or extractable from the fetched website content.
Website navigation includes a 'Wheelchair Accessibility' page but no detail was captured in the fetch; no mention of bike parking.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, well-established, publicly accessible farm market and bakery with confirmed food offerings — a natural stop for touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley.
